# charm-cdp

> Public API reference that truesight generates from the compiler's rustdoc output, except the task names and calls, which come from the task file.

## charm-cdp 0.1.0

- [Every public item, one per line](reference/charm-cdp/api.txt): 1238 lines
- [API overview](reference/charm-cdp/index.html): tasks, modules, features, and examples
- [API changes by release](reference/charm-cdp/changes.html)
- [charm](reference/charm-cdp/charm.html): 622 items
- [charm::human](reference/charm-cdp/charm-human.html): 130 items
- [Example agent_loop](reference/charm-cdp/examples/agent_loop.html): `cargo run -p charm-cdp --example agent_loop`
- [Example intercept](reference/charm-cdp/examples/intercept.html): `cargo run -p charm-cdp --example intercept`
- [Example keep_login](reference/charm-cdp/examples/keep_login.html): `cargo run -p charm-cdp --example keep_login`
- [Example search_form](reference/charm-cdp/examples/search_form.html): `cargo run -p charm-cdp --example search_form`
